title_en: Kwanjeong Educational Foundation 2027 New Undergraduate Scholarship: Call for Applicants
summary: Undergraduate students who will enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher may apply for the 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation new undergraduate scholarship. Applicants must first read the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2) and then submit the required documents to the department office by Friday, 13 November 2026. Students recommended by the university will later receive an email from the foundation about online document submission.
applies_to: Optional; for interested undergraduate students only. Applicants must be due to enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) and have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher. Further eligibility rules, including an age limit, are in the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2), which was not read. Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 in total.

conditions: Applicants must be due to enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 and have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher.
Further eligibility conditions, such as an age limit, are set out in Attachment 2 and must be checked there.
Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 students in total.
Students may choose between Type A and Type B.

Type A (Kwanjeong Academic Excellence Scholarship) pays KRW 6,000,000 per semester for up to 4 semesters, covering tuition and a study allowance, and cannot be combined with any other scholarship, including national and university scholarships.
Type B (Kwanjeong Study Encouragement Scholarship) pays up to KRW 4,000,000 per semester for up to 4 semesters as a study allowance and may be combined with national and university scholarships.
Scholarships from other private foundations cannot be received at the same time.
If a student receives national or university scholarships that cover both tuition and living costs, the scholarship amount will be adjusted.
Students who pass the document screening must take part in the expert review (second stage) and the interview (third stage); the interview schedule is in Attachment 2.

The notice is inconsistent about which attachments to submit: the document list names Attachments 3 and 4, but the notes say Attachments 4 and 5, and no Attachment 5 is listed; please confirm with the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
steps: Read the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2-1, '2027년 국내대학 장학생 선발계획.pdf') and the scholarship regulations (Attachment 2-2) for full eligibility rules, including the age limit, and the interview schedule.
Choose whether to apply for Type A or Type B.

Complete the 2027 Kwanjeong Scholar Recommendation List (Attachment 3, '2027년도 관정장학생 추천명단(학부).xlsx') and the Consent Form for the Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (Attachment 4, '개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서').
Submit these documents to the department office by Friday, 13 November 2026 (the notice does not give a room number; the contact is in the original notice).
If you are recommended by the university, watch for an email from the foundation and complete the online document submission as instructed.
If you pass the document screening, take part in the expert review (second stage) and the interview (third stage) according to the schedule in Attachment 2.
translation:
2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Undergraduate Scholars: Call for Applicants

The Kwanjeong Educational Foundation will select new undergraduate scholars for 2027 as set out below. Interested students should refer to the selection plan in Attachment 2 and submit the required documents to the department office by Friday, 13 November 2026 (2026. 11. 13.(금)).

A. Number of recommendations: at most 2 students per department (school). ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 students.

B. Eligibility: students who will enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher.
※ For detailed eligibility such as the age limit, see the scholar selection plan [Attachment 2].

C. Scholarship amount and support period ※ Students may choose Type A or Type B.

- Kwanjeong Academic Excellence Scholarship (Type A) [관정성적우수장학금(A형)]: undergraduate; KRW 6,000,000 per semester (up to 4 semesters); tuition and study allowance; cannot be combined with any other scholarship (including national and university scholarships).
- Kwanjeong Study Encouragement Scholarship (Type B) [관정학업장려장학금(B형)]: undergraduate; up to KRW 4,000,000 per semester (up to 4 semesters); study allowance; may be combined with national and university scholarships.
※ Scholarships from other private foundations cannot be received at the same time.
※ If national or university scholarships cover both tuition and living costs, the scholarship amount will be adjusted.

D. Documents to submit
1. 2027 Kwanjeong Scholar Recommendation List (Attachment 3)
2. Consent Form for the Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (Attachment 4)

F. Notes (the notice skips item E)
1) For full details of the scholar selection, you must check the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2).
2) The foundation will email students recommended by the university with instructions for online document submission.
3) Students who pass the document screening must take part in the expert review (second stage) and the interview (third stage). (For the interview schedule, see the plan in Attachment 2.)
4) Students wishing to apply must submit Attachments 4 and 5 to the department office by Friday, 13 November (11월 13일(금)). (The contact person, phone number and email are given in the original notice.) [Note: this conflicts with item D, which lists Attachments 3 and 4, and no Attachment 5 is listed; please confirm with the department office.]

Attachments (4 files; their contents were not read)
2-1. 2027 Domestic University Scholar Selection Plan (2027년 국내대학 장학생 선발계획.pdf, 448 KB)
2-2. Regulations on Domestic University Scholar Selection and Scholarship Payment, 10th amendment (국내대학장학생선발및장학금지급규정(10차 개정).pdf, 97 KB)
3. 2027 Kwanjeong Scholar Recommendation List (Undergraduate) (2027년도 관정장학생 추천명단(학부).xlsx, 12 KB)
4. Consent Form for the Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (Scholarship and Welfare Division, external foundations) (개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서(장학복지과_교외재단).hwp, 18 KB)
